params:
  # ---- Required parameters ----
  sample_sheet: null
  consensus_peaks: null
  group_var: "Condition"
  target_group: null
  ref_group: null
  # ---- Optional: data processing ----
  stitch_distance: null
  normalization_method: "TotalSignal"
  bg_quantile: 0.1
  workers: 1
  on_disk: false
  h5_dir: "epiPortrait_h5"
  # ---- Optional: statistical cutoffs ----
  p_cutoff: 0.05
  fc_cutoff: 1
  # ---- Optional: annotation ----
  annotation_genome: null
  tss_region: [-3000, 3000]
  # ---- Optional: super-domain ----
  super_domain_feature: null
  # ---- Optional: visualization tweaks ----
  n_top_pca: 500
  top_n_label: 10
  # ---- Metadata ----
  report_title: "epiPortrait Analysis Report"
  author: "epiPortrait"
  output_dir: "."
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)

library(epiPortrait)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ggplot2)

# Helper: conditionally include a chunk section via a labelled list
.has <- function(x) !is.null(x) && length(x) > 0
```

```{r load-data, include = .has(params$consensus_peaks)}
# Load inputs and build portrait matrix ---------------------------------------
if (is.character(params$sample_sheet)) {
  sample_sheet <- read.csv(params$sample_sheet, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  sample_sheet <- params$sample_sheet
}

if (is.character(params$consensus_peaks)) {
  consensus_peaks <- rtracklayer::import(params$consensus_peaks)
} else {
  consensus_peaks <- params$consensus_peaks
}

stopifnot(
  all(c("SampleID", "Condition", "bw_path") %in% colnames(sample_sheet)),
  is(consensus_peaks, "GRanges")
)

cat(sprintf("### Input Summary\n\n- **Samples**: %d\n- **Consensus peaks**: %d\n- **Groups**: %s\n\n",
    nrow(sample_sheet), length(consensus_peaks),
    paste(unique(sample_sheet[[params$group_var]]), collapse = ", ")))

se <- build_portrait_matrix(
  sample_sheet = sample_sheet,
  consensus_peaks = consensus_peaks,
  workers = params$workers,
  bg_quantile = params$bg_quantile,
  on_disk = params$on_disk,
  h5_dir = params$h5_dir
)
```

# Data Processing {#processing}

```{r normalize, eval = params$normalization_method != "None"}
se <- normalize_portrait(se, method = params$normalization_method)
```

```{r stitch, eval = .has(params$stitch_distance)}
stitched <- stitch_epi_peaks(consensus_peaks,
                              stitch_distance = params$stitch_distance)
cat(sprintf("Stitching complete: %d peaks → %d macro-domains (distance = %d bp).\n\n",
            length(consensus_peaks), length(stitched), params$stitch_distance))
# Rebuild portrait on stitched domains
se <- build_portrait_matrix(
  sample_sheet = sample_sheet,
  consensus_peaks = stitched,
  workers = params$workers,
  bg_quantile = params$bg_quantile,
  on_disk = params$on_disk,
  h5_dir = params$h5_dir
)
if (params$normalization_method != "None") {
  se <- normalize_portrait(se, method = params$normalization_method)
}
```

# Quality Control {#qc}

```{r pca, fig.cap = paste("PCA of", params$group_var, "based on normalized Intensity")}
plot_portrait_pca(se, feature = "Intensity",
                  group_var = params$group_var,
                  n_top = params$n_top_pca)
```

```{r correlation, fig.cap = "Sample Pearson correlation heatmap (normalized)"}
plot_portrait_correlation(se, feature = "Intensity")
```

# Global Shape Shift Test (MANOVA) {#global-shift}

```{r global-shift, message = TRUE}
shift_res <- test_global_shape_shift(
  se, group_var = params$group_var,
  workers = params$workers
)

n_sig <- sum(shift_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("**%d** regions show significant shape shift (adj.P.Val < %s).\n\n",
            n_sig, params$p_cutoff))
```

```{r global-shift-table}
knitr::kable(
  head(shift_res[shift_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff, ], 20),
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Top 20 significantly shape-shifted regions"
)
```

# Shape Shift Classification {#classification}

```{r classify, message = TRUE}
shift_res <- classify_shape_shift(
  se, shift_res,
  group_var = params$group_var,
  target_group = params$target_group,
  ref_group = params$ref_group
)
```

```{r class-summary}
class_tab <- as.data.frame(table(shift_res$Shape_Class))
colnames(class_tab) <- c("Shape Class", "Count")
class_tab <- class_tab[order(class_tab$Count, decreasing = TRUE), ]
rownames(class_tab) <- NULL
knitr::kable(class_tab, caption = "Shape Shift classification summary")

cat("\n### Class Descriptions\n\n",
    "- **Concentration**: Height increases without Intensity gain — signal concentrates at the summit.\n",
    "- **Flattening**: Height decreases while Intensity stable — signal spreads across the domain.\n",
    "- **Polarity Shift**: Skewness changes dominate — signal redistributes asymmetrically.\n",
    "- **Global Gain**: Coordinated increase in signal abundance.\n",
    "- **Global Loss**: Coordinated decrease in signal abundance.\n",
    "- **Complex**: Multiple dimensions shift in discordant directions.\n",
    "- **Stable**: No significant geometric change detected.\n\n")
```

```{r class-table}
sig_class <- shift_res[shift_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff, ]
sig_class <- sig_class[order(sig_class$adj.P.Val), ]
knitr::kable(
  head(sig_class[, c("Peak_ID", "Shape_Shift_Score", "adj.P.Val",
                     "Shape_Class", "Class_Label")], 20),
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Top 20 classified shape-shifted regions"
)
```

# Differential Feature Analysis {#diff-feature}

```{r diff-test, message = TRUE}
diff_res <- test_differential_feature(
  se,
  feature = "Intensity",
  group_var = params$group_var,
  target_group = params$target_group,
  ref_group = params$ref_group,
  method = "limma",
  workers = params$workers
)

n_up   <- sum(diff_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff & diff_res$logFC >  params$fc_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
n_down <- sum(diff_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff & diff_res$logFC < -params$fc_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("- **Up** (logFC > %.1f): %d\n- **Down** (logFC < %.1f): %d\n\n",
            params$fc_cutoff, n_up, -params$fc_cutoff, n_down))
```

```{r diff-table}
diff_sig <- diff_res[diff_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff, ]
diff_sig <- diff_sig[order(diff_sig$adj.P.Val), ]
knitr::kable(head(diff_sig, 20), digits = 4,
             caption = "Top 20 differentially intense regions")
```

# Visualization {#visualization}

## 4D Volcano Plot {#volcano}

```{r volcano, fig.cap = paste("4D volcano:", params$target_group, "vs", params$ref_group), fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
plot_portrait_volcano(
  res_df = diff_res,
  se = se,
  group_var = params$group_var,
  target_group = params$target_group,
  ref_group = params$ref_group,
  p_cutoff = params$p_cutoff,
  fc_cutoff = params$fc_cutoff
)
```

## Top Shifted Peaks — Radar Portraits {#radar}

```{r radar-top, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 12, warning = FALSE}
top_ids <- head(shift_res$Peak_ID[shift_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff], 6)
if (length(top_ids) > 0) {
  plots <- lapply(top_ids, function(pid) {
    plot_peak_portrait(se, peak_id = pid, group_var = params$group_var) +
      ggtitle(pid)
  })
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = min(3, length(plots)))
} else {
  cat("*No significantly shifted peaks at the current threshold.*\n\n")
}
```

## Coverage Tracks — Individual Samples {#tracks}

```{r tracks, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 10, warning = FALSE}
if (length(top_ids) > 0) {
  for (pid in head(top_ids, 3)) {
    p <- plot_peak_track(se, peak_id = pid,
                         group_var = params$group_var,
                         extend_bp = 1000)
    print(p)
  }
}
```

## Shape Shift Validation — Group Overlays {#overlay}

```{r overlay, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10, warning = FALSE}
if (length(top_ids) > 0) {
  for (pid in head(top_ids, 4)) {
    p <- plot_shift_comparison(
      se, peak_id = pid,
      group_var = params$group_var,
      group1 = params$ref_group,
      group2 = params$target_group,
      extend_bp = 1000
    )
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Super-Domain Identification {#super-domain}

```{r super-domain, eval = .has(params$super_domain_feature), fig.cap = "ROSE-style ranking plot"}
se <- call_super_domains(se, feature = params$super_domain_feature)
plot_hockey_stick(se, feature = params$super_domain_feature,
                   label_genes = TRUE,
                   top_n_label = params$top_n_label)

types <- table(rowData(se)[[paste0(params$super_domain_feature, "_Domain_Type")]])
cat(sprintf("**Domain classification** (%s): %s\n\n",
            params$super_domain_feature,
            paste(names(types), types, sep = " = ", collapse = ", ")))
```

# Genomic Annotation {#annotation}

```{r annotation, eval = .has(params$annotation_genome), message = TRUE}
sig_peaks <- shift_res[shift_res$adj.P.Val < params$p_cutoff, ]
if (nrow(sig_peaks) > 0) {
  anno_df <- annotate_epi_peaks(
    gr = sig_peaks,
    genome = params$annotation_genome,
    tss_region = params$tss_region,
    return_format = "dataframe"
  )
  knitr::kable(head(anno_df, 20), digits = 4,
               caption = "Annotation of significantly shifted regions")
} else {
  cat("*No significant peaks to annotate.*\n\n")
}
```

# BED Export {#export}

```{r export}
export_shifted_bed(
  shift_res,
  file = file.path(params$output_dir, "epiPortrait_shifted_peaks.bed"),
  fdr_cutoff = params$p_cutoff
)
cat(sprintf("Exported shifted peaks to `%s/epiPortrait_shifted_peaks.bed`.\n\n",
            params$output_dir))
```

sessionInfo()
